guide_solution: Match Column A, Column B and Column C: (a) Street children are a common sight in Bangladesh. (b) They are often seen wearing torn clothes and bare-footed. (c) Many of them come out from their house before the sunrise and go back after sun set. (d) Sometimes they are seen playing in the scorching heat of the sun. (e) Sometimes they quarrel but again they play together.
